messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished to eu-west-1 for release v2.4.3. Post-deploy smoke started at 23:11 UTC — canary=25%. synth-bot will post probe stats.
maria: seeing p95 bump on embed-synth in eu1, baseline ~1.9s -> 3.1s. Anyone else?
rajesh: yep, p95 spike and a few 502/503s on /generate-stream. errors ~0.6% on canary slice.
ben: API gateway showing short 502 bursts, logs point at inference-proxy upstream timeouts around 23:12.
synth-bot: probe eu1 embed-synth p95=3100ms (baseline 1900ms), errors=0.7%, probe_retries=2
sasha: possible KV warmup miss — I see a flurry of evictions on kvcache around the deploy window. Can we kick a warmup?
maria: hold the rollout at 25% — don't advance until two clean synth probes. Pin canary instances to v2.4.3-canary only for now.
prod-oncall: holding. If p95 > 2.5s for two consecutive probes, we should prepare a rollback plan. @lin @sasha
lin: thinking to add a smart probe retry policy: increase probe retries to 4 with exponential backoff (200ms -> 800ms) and extend probe window to 90s. That should reduce noisy failures from transient starts.en: caution — more retries can hide real infra regressions. Suggest we run a focused uncached probe that bypasses prefix/KV cache to determine cache vs runtime root cause.
maria: agreed. synth-bot, start 'embed-synth uncached' job and post results (no caching headers, cold run).
synth-bot: running 'embed-synth uncached' now... results in 30s: p95=2900ms, errors=0.2%
rajesh: uncached still high — points at model runtime or variant issue rather than just cache warmup. Which variant did we deploy to canary?
deploy-bot: Deployed variant v2.4.3-quant-32bit to eu1 canary pool as part of this rollout.
sasha: OK revert canary to v2.4.3-standard variant and roll pods. Can we pin canary pool to standard variant only while we investigate quant variant?
lin: executing pin -> rolling restart for canary nodes to standard variant. Command: /deploy pin canary eu1 variant=standard
deploy-bot: Pin command accepted. Rolling restart started (5 nodes). ETA approx 4m.
maria: also temporarily relax synth alert window: p95 threshold -> 3.5s for the next 10m to prevent premature automated rollback while nodes warm.
prod-oncall: fine, but keep alerting on error rate. Trigger if errors > 1% sustained for 5m.
ben: infra note — I see GC spikes on two hosts at 23:10, memory footprint increased when quant kernels loaded. Monitoring memory and host metrics closely.
synth-bot: post-pin check in 2m: embed-synth p95=1800ms, errors=0.05% — back to baseline :tada:
maria: great. Advancing rollout to 50% after one more clean probe cycle.
rajesh: action item for release notes: document that quant-32bit variant may cause transient latency increases on some GPU drivers; recommend pre-warm and optional variant pinning during canary.
sasha: will add note to releases/2.4.3.md and ping partners about the variant caveat.
maria: clearing the hold flag now. No rollback performed. Thanks all for quick ops and probe adjustments.
lin: +1 :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Note: rollout resumed, canary->50%. All probe config changes temporary (10m) unless otherwise noted.
